bullets.title: No Surprise Pricing

faqs.a: If you are seeing ants, roaches, spiders or wasps, General Pest Defense covers it. Termite damage or a WDO report for a home sale needs our termite service. Scratching in the attic or walls is rodent and wildlife work. If you are unsure, request a free quote and we will tell you which one fits.

faqs.q: Can I combine more than one service?
faqs.a: Yes. Plenty of customers pair General Pest Defense with a termite bond, and we schedule both around the same visit window where possible so you are not managing two calendars.

We do, but we will be honest about when it makes sense. A single treatment can knock down an active problem; keeping it gone on the Gulf Coast takes a recurring schedule. We will quote both and let you choose.
